exposure: Physician's routine practices for PONV prevention
outcome: Use of specific PONV medications (metoclopramide, 5-hydroxytryptamine receptor antagonists)
Proportion of physicians using two or more agents for PONV prophylaxis
cohort: The participants were 307 active members of the Japan Society of Obstetric Anesthesiology and Perinatology (JSOAP).
finding: Physicians using neuraxial opioids for cesarean delivery showed a higher proportion of multimodal postoperative nausea and vomiting management involving two or more prophylactic agents compared to those who did not.
cross-section timing: The study investigated current clinical practices among obstetric anesthesiologists in Japan.
